questions.text: How long does the bleeding step take after slaughter?
questions.explanation: The bleeding step — blood drainage time after slaughter — takes 3:30 minutes. This timing is specified in the slaughterhouse process flow.

questions.text: What is the total Evisceration (EV) process time?
questions.explanation: The total EV (Evisceration) Process time is 5:07 minutes — the longest single stage in the slaughterhouse workflow.

questions.text: What is the cycle time for hanging birds on the processing line?
questions.explanation: The Hanging step has a cycle time of 55 seconds — birds are hung on the processing line at this rate.

questions.text: What happens to Grade C carcasses after grading?
options: They are packaged as whole birds
They are transferred to cold storage
They are sent to Portioning / Further Processing
questions.explanation: Grade C carcasses are sent to Portioning (Grade C → Portion) and further processed. Grade A carcasses are packaged as whole birds.

questions.text: The slaughterhouse workflow is divided into which two zones?
questions.explanation: The slaughterhouse workflow is divided into the Dirty Area (from live bird receipt through evisceration) and the Clean Area (from packing through storage).

questions.text: How long after unloading are crates left before processing begins?
questions.explanation: The process specifies 'Leave boxes 30 min after unloading' — crates/boxes are unloaded and birds are rested for 30 minutes before processing begins.

questions.text: What is the purpose of the MDM Machine in Grade C further processing?
options: It separates wings from the carcass
questions.explanation: MDM stands for Mechanically Deboned Meat machine — it produces MDM product from bone-in portions during Grade C further processing.

questions.text: What is the scalding time in the Plucker Area?
questions.explanation: Scalding — where carcasses are dipped in hot water to loosen feathers — takes 1:55 minutes. The overall Scalding-to-Stunning sub-section takes 1:25 minutes total.

questions.text: What is the correct order of steps in the Evisceration Area?
options: Leg Cutting → Vent Cutting → Vent Opening → Eviscerating → Crop Machine → Neck Cracker → Final Inspection → Sanitizing
Hanging → Slaughtering → Bleeding → Head Pulling → Eviscerating
questions.explanation: The Evisceration Area steps in order: Leg Cutting → Vent Cutting → Vent Opening → Eviscerating → Crop Machine → Neck Cracker → Final Inspection Machine → Sanitizing.
